about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking NVIDIA Corporation. Users get linear exposure to NVIDIA share-price moves without owning NVIDIA shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims, with pricing referencing an external 24/5 equity feed. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
